instrument: November 3 2026 local ballot measures on data centers (18 Ohio municipalities and townships)
summary: Eighteen Ohio municipalities and townships vote November 3 2026 on data center measures. Nine mirror the proposed statewide 25 MW ban: Conneaut, Defiance, Granville, Oregon, Pataskala, Piqua, Sunbury, Trenton and Upper Sandusky. Others include two Adams County township rural-character zoning plans, four Wilmington referendums plus a residents' alternative ordinance, an Ashville referendum and Sidney petitions.
notes: The count of 18 is Ohio Capital Journal's. Per-community entries need county board of elections certification.
confidence_note: Relayed from reporting; no ballot language read.
